claim: Confidential swaps still settle on the destination chain as standard public transactions; only the origin and route are hidden
observed: 100.0% of 18,276 USDT on Tron payouts ($156.6M, 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-10) traced to a public intents.near withdrawal; median bridge fee 0.83 USDT, median delay 12s
limitation: PARTIAL, not PASS: every payout from the bridge's hot wallet is public and auditable on both chains, but we cannot single out which began as confidential swaps. If confidential payouts on this route exist, they either pass through a public NEAR withdrawal (origin hidden, withdrawal visible) or leave from a wallet we have not identified. One route, one week; output that stays inside Intents never reaches custody.
